'''Kiyomi Asai''' (Japanese: '''浅井清己''' ''Asai Kiyomi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Asai was born on April 12, 1974 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. Asai began her work in {{aniseries|PTS}} during the [[DP191|final episode]] of {{aniseries|DP}}, voicing one of her most significant roles as [[Matori]]. She has also voiced various Pokémon during {{aniseries|BW}}. Throughout her career, Asai has also been credited under a number of aliases, including '''Don Ohana''' (Japanese: '''大花どん''' ''Ohana Don''), '''Kiyosato Otomo''' (Japanese: '''大友清里''' ''Otomo Kiyosato''), '''Yuria Hokuto''' (Japanese: '''ほくとゆりあ''' ''Hokuto Yuria''), '''Shinya Aizaki''' (Japanese: '''愛咲深夜''' ''Aizaki Shinya''), '''Remi Haruno''' (Japanese: '''春野レミ''' ''Haruno Remi''), and '''Midori Amamiya''' (Japanese: '''雨宮みどり''' ''Amamiya Midori''). Asai is currently affiliated with D-Color.
